name: before
body:
Set src = Workbooks.Add
Set dst = Workbooks.Add
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
src.Worksheets.Add(After:=src.Worksheets(1)).Name = "Second"
src.Worksheets.Add(After:=src.Worksheets(2)).Name = "Third"
src.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = 7
src.Worksheets("Third").Move Before:=src.Worksheets(1)
Report = CStr(ActiveWorkbook Is dst) & ":" & ActiveSheet.Name & "|"
For Each bk In Workbooks
If bk Is src Or bk Is dst Then
If bk Is src Then
Report = Report & "source:"
Else
Report = Report & "destination:"
End If
For Each sh In bk.Worksheets
Report = Report & sh.Name & ","
Next sh
For Each nm In bk.Names
Report = Report & nm.Name & "=" & nm.RefersTo & ","
Next nm
Report = Report & "|"
End If
Next bk

name: names
body:
Set src = Workbooks.Add
Set dst = Workbooks.Add

src.Worksheets.Add(After:=src.Worksheets(1)).Name = "Second"
src.Worksheets.Add(After:=src.Worksheets(2)).Name = "Third"
src.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = 7
src.Names.Add "GlobalAmount", "=Sheet1!$A$1"
src.Worksheets(1).Names.Add "LocalAmount", "=Sheet1!$A$1"
src.Worksheets(1).Range("B1").Formula = "=GlobalAmount+LocalAmount"
